policy: Each review burst must be readable in under 20 seconds and use plain-language decision prompts.

pending_bursts.what_decision_am_i_making: Do we approve the migration target to Next.js App Router + TypeScript strict mode + shared design system as the single frontend stack for this reset cycle?
pending_bursts.why_it_matters: One approved target prevents split implementation and rework across teams.
pending_bursts.recommended_default: Approve default — lock this as the migration target now.
pending_bursts.if_approve_what_happens_next: Architecture docs and implementation tickets align to one stack path.
pending_bursts.if_revise_what_to_provide: Name the replacement stack target and why it beats the default.

pending_bursts.what_decision_am_i_making: Do we approve the Home IA v2 component map as the source of truth for Home layout and content blocks?
pending_bursts.why_it_matters: Locking the map avoids duplicate or conflicting Home modules.
pending_bursts.recommended_default: Approve default — use Home IA v2 component map as canonical.
pending_bursts.if_approve_what_happens_next: Home build proceeds against one component map and acceptance checklist.
pending_bursts.if_revise_what_to_provide: Specify exact component changes (add/remove/move) before build freeze.

pending_bursts.what_decision_am_i_making: Do we approve a persistent top nav + contextual side nav pattern for enterprise UX across core routes?
pending_bursts.why_it_matters: A single nav pattern reduces cognitive load and onboarding time for operators.
pending_bursts.recommended_default: Approve default — standardize on top + side nav now.
pending_bursts.if_approve_what_happens_next: Navigation implementation and QA follow one enterprise pattern.
pending_bursts.if_revise_what_to_provide: Define the alternate nav pattern and which routes are exceptions.

pending_bursts.what_decision_am_i_making: Do we keep Account Workspace + Individual Workspace split as the default this cycle?
pending_bursts.why_it_matters: This is the main workflow pattern; changing it now can reintroduce confusion.
pending_bursts.recommended_default: Approve default — keep split views as standard.
pending_bursts.if_approve_what_happens_next: Split views stay live and release copy remains controlled.
pending_bursts.if_revise_what_to_provide: State the exact layout change and where it should apply.

pending_bursts.what_decision_am_i_making: Must every review close pass the full checklist route?
pending_bursts.why_it_matters: It prevents incomplete sign-off from summary-only views.
pending_bursts.recommended_default: Approve default — checklist pass required before close.
pending_bursts.if_approve_what_happens_next: Reviews cannot close without checklist completion.
pending_bursts.if_revise_what_to_provide: Specify which checklist step can be optional and why.

pending_bursts.what_decision_am_i_making: Do we wait for one more full end-to-end pass before expanding?
pending_bursts.why_it_matters: One clean replay reduces rollback risk.
pending_bursts.recommended_default: Approve default — wait for one more all-pass replay.
pending_bursts.if_approve_what_happens_next: Current scope stays in place until replay is posted.
pending_bursts.if_revise_what_to_provide: Name what can expand now and what risk you accept.

pending_bursts.what_decision_am_i_making: Should Zephyr's 47→57 (+10) result be the reference proof for this cycle?
pending_bursts.why_it_matters: It ties UI changes to a concrete business outcome.
pending_bursts.recommended_default: Approve default — use Zephyr delta as reference proof.
pending_bursts.if_approve_what_happens_next: Cycle summary and training use this example.
pending_bursts.if_revise_what_to_provide: Name the replacement example and link supporting proof.
